evaluation: constructed MS MARCO mined-triplet validation candidate lists; not leaderboard comparable
evaluation_precision: fp32 for every checkpoint; isolates training precision
timing_caveat: One short epoch per mode; do not infer a stable speed ranking without repeats.
memory_caveat: Sampled current MPS allocations, not true peaks.

fp32.training_time_scope: 64 training batches: tokenization, device transfer, forward, backward, gradient finite check, optimizer/scaler update; excludes loading, validation, save
fp32.memory_measurement: maximum sampled MPS current allocation with activations live, after backward, after update; not true peak
